mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_oauth_unlink_job (account_id, provider, subject, created_at, next_publish_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, 'KAKAO', #{subject}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, subject FROM account_oauth_unlink_job WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE account_oauth_unlink_job SET next_publish_at = #{next} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND next_publish_at <= #{now}
UPDATE account_oauth_unlink_job SET last_published_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE account_oauth_unlink_job j SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{now} WHERE j.id = #{id} AND j.status = 'QUEUED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account a WHERE a.id = j.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_oauth_identity i WHERE i.account_id = j.account_id AND i.provider = j.provider AND i.subject = j.subject)
UPDATE account_oauth_unlink_job SET status = #{status}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE account_oauth_unlink_job SET status = 'UNKNOWN', failure_code = 'WORKER_INTERRUPTED', finished_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at <= #{cutoff}
